name: com.biomata.sdk
description: Client SDK for driving biomata-engine autonomous agent simulations from Unity. Default transport is JSON over WebSocket (Unity 6-friendly, works on every platform including WebGL).

samples.description: Minimal scene that verifies the SDK compiles and connects to a running biomata-engine server (biomata-ws or biomata-grpc). Provides Connect / Health Check / Register Agent buttons and a live event log.

Visual proof that Biomata drives gameplay: two NPC capsules patrol waypoint loops driven entirely by Python WaypointBrain decisions. No LLM required. Backend: biomata-ws --config examples/patrol/sim.yaml --port 8765.

Full LLM pipeline demo: OllamaLLMBrain drives a cube NPC to navigate in Unity via WebSocket. Connect → Register Agent → watch the cube move based on LLM decisions. Backend: biomata-ws --config examples/visual_demo/sim.yaml --port 8765.
